description: Delete one guided camera tour from a scene. Use it when the user wants to remove a tour they no longer want; to replace the automatic tour with a fresh plan use reset_auto_camera_path, and to add a tour use set_camera_path. Parameters: `scene` (id or link) and `path_id` from list_camera_paths or set_camera_path; 'default' deletes whichever tour currently plays by default. Permanent: the tour cannot be restored, though reset_auto_camera_path can plan a new automatic one. If it was the default, links play no tour until another is made default. Other tours and the scene are untouched. Owner only. Requires sign-in (connector sign-in, or VERSE_API_KEY for the local server).

path_id.description: Id of the tour to delete, as listed by list_camera_paths, or 'default' for the tour that currently plays by default.

scene.description: Scene id (e.g. palm-villa-0a1b2c3d4e5f), the job id returned by upload_scene, or a Verse share link.

name: delete_camera_path

default.description: Id of the tour that now plays by default, or null if none.

deleted.description: Id of the tour that was deleted.

title: Delete a camera path
